chapters.label: The first free kick
chapters.text: Arsenal against Real Madrid, 2025. Declan Rice has never scored a free kick. He steps up, and curls it round the wall... Goal!

chapters.label: Watch it again
chapters.text: Watch it again. It starts outside the post, then bends back inside. Courtois dives, but it's just too good!

chapters.label: Another one!
chapters.text: Twelve minutes later, another one! Over the wall and into the top corner. Rice leaps onto the boards, arms wide!

chapters.label: The secret
chapters.text: The secret? Practise! Rice had practised free kicks again and again. Wrap your foot round the ball, and it bends round the wall.
